_meta.notes: TYPED form - the '2014 Financial Disclosure Report For County and Local School Board Candidates [County Officeholders - Year-End]' blank. The Year-End box is checked; neither amendment box is checked. Signature date 2/2/15 and clerk-stamped FEB 02 2015, but the Summary Page header box is dated 'January 30, 2015' (Page 2 of 7, McAdams) - the two dates disagree by three days. A handwritten '15' is circled at the top of the cover (a clerk annotation). Column B ('Year to Date') equals Column A on both lines. Column A arithmetic checks out (43,181.28 + 268,232.00 = 311,413.28; minus 180,904.12 = 130,509.16) and Line 3 chains exactly to the 2013 year-end's Line 7.

itemized.itemized_pages_A: 8-12 (attached spreadsheet; form p3 says 'See attached spreadsheet')
itemized.itemized_pages_B: 13-15 (attached spreadsheet; form p4 says 'See attached spreadsheet')

contributions.detail: exact (268232.00 = 268,232.00); the attached contributions spreadsheet's own printed grand total on p12 is $268,232.00 and the 155 transcribed rows sum to it to the cent

expenditures.detail: exact (180904.12 = 180,904.12); the attached expenditures spreadsheet's own printed grand total on p15 is $180,904.12 and the 122 transcribed rows sum to it to the cent

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NO page-subtotal gate exists on the FORM pages: p3 (Itemized Contributions Received) and p4 (Itemized Expenditures Made) carry only 'See attached spreadsheet' and their SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE / TOTAL cells were left blank by the filer. The gate that fired instead is the attachment's own printed GRAND TOTAL: contributions p12 prints $268,232.00 and rows p8-p12 sum 54,355.00 + 58,450.00 + 80,050.00 + 49,412.00 + 25,965.00 = 268,232.00 (exact); expenditures p15 prints $180,904.12 and rows p13-p15 sum 115,594.96 + 52,621.33 + 12,687.83 = 180,904.12 (exact). The attachment pages print no per-page subtotals, so the per-page figures above are rows-sums only, not printed subtotals.
itemized.escalation_note: No cell escalation was needed: the attachment is a TYPED spreadsheet printout. Contribution pages 8-12 are LANDSCAPE and were rendered at 300 dpi, rotated 90 deg counter-clockwise (clockwise rendered the sheet upside down - the sign is per file), then read as two overlapping row bands per page. Expenditure pages 13-15 are portrait and were read as full pages at 200 dpi. The exact two-sided grand-total closure (zero delta on 277 rows) is the arithmetic gate that adjudicates every amount digit.
itemized.notes: BUNDLE / non-standard structure. p1 cover, p2 Summary Page (already transcribed in the totals tranche, not redone). p3 = the form's Itemized Contributions Received page, filled only with 'See attached spreadsheet'. p4 = the form's Itemized Expenditures Made page, likewise. p5 = 'Summary Page - Other Campaign Accounts', p6 = 'Itemized Contributions -- Other Campaign Accounts', p7 = 'Itemized Expenditures -- Other Campaign Accounts' - all three marked 'Not applicable' by the filer, so no Other-Accounts rows exist. p8-p12 = the attached 'Ben McAdams for Mayor - 2014 Contributions' spreadsheet (LANDSCAPE, 5 pages, 35/35/35/35/15 rows, grand total printed on p12). p13-p15 = the attached 'Ben McAdams for Mayor - 2014 Expenditures' spreadsheet (portrait, 3 pages, 53/53/16 rows, grand total printed on p15). PRIVACY: the attachment has an Address column, blacked out as a solid county redaction bar on every row of every page; no street address was read or recorded. City and State are separate printed columns and are recorded. The attachment also prints Zip, Occupation and Employer columns; zip was NOT recorded (address-adjacent), occupation/employer are recorded in each row's note.
